findings.title: Journal page shows a malformed API response as a list of blank entries with a success count
findings.expected: When the journal response is not a JSON list, the page shows an error such as 'Could not load the journal.' and no entry count
findings.actual: The page reports '14 entries' and draws 14 cards that show only '–' (no plant name, date or text), with no error
